messages:
customer_orion: Hi team  ACH pay_03MZ4H9 returned with bank note "Invalid routing number: incorrect length". We submitted routing 011000015 and account 000987654321. Please advise.

sarah_support: sorry to hear that  pulling the outbound file now. @mike_sre can you take a look at the pipeline? Include the raw CSV the customer uploaded.

mike_sre: grabbing logs. Outbound ACH record shows routing `11000015` (8 digits) on pay_03MZ4H9looks like leading zero dropped.

eli_finance: that explains the checksum failure. If routing became 8 digits it will fail ABA checksum and be rejected by the bank. Did the customer paste an extra zero or did we lose it server-side?

mike_sre: repro from batch importer: our CSV parser does `const routing = parseInt(row.routing, 10)` to "clean" the field. parseInt("011000015") => 11000015 (number), later we convert to string `routing.toString()` which drops the leading zero. Repro steps:
1) Upload CSV with routing=011000015
2) pipeline.parse => { routing: 11000015 }
3) enqueue => send '11000015' downstream

sarah_support: ugh. That would affect any customer uploading CSVs with leading-zero RTNs. How many affected?

payments-bot: Automated search: found 12 ACHs in last 72h where sent_routing.length !== 9 and returned RTN_CHECKSUM_FAILED -> [pay_03MZ4H9, pay_03MZ5A1, pay_03MZ6B2, pay_03MZ7C3, pay_03MZ8D4, pay_03MZ9E5, pay_03MZ9F6, pay_03MZ9G7, pay_03MZ9H8, pay_03MZ9J9, pay_03MZ9K0, pay_03MZ9L1].

eli_finance: finance note: all affected are currently RETURNED; ledger shows no final settlement. We'll hold re-init until fix. Need list of customers to notify.

mike_sre: creating ENG ticket ENG-10111. Proposed fix:
- Update CSV parser to treat routing as string, don't parseInt
- Normalize via `routing = row.routing.replace(/\D/g,'').padStart(9,'0')` and then validate ABA checksum
- Add server-side hard validation that rejects anything not matching `/^\d{9}$/` and fails job ingestion
- Add unit tests for CSV inputs with leading zeros

mike_sre: quick patch snippet:
```
// preserve leading zeros
const raw = row.routing || '';
const routing = raw.replace(/\D/g, '').padStart(9, '0');
if(!/^[0-9]{9}$/.test(routing)) throw new Error('invalid routing');
```

sarah_support: timeline? customers want ETA.

mike_sre: hotfix PR ready. If CI passes, plan deploy 16:30 UTC today, monitor 1h, then reprocess batch 17:45 UTC. Will publish rollback steps in ENG-10111.

eli_finance: after deploy provide CSV of affected tx + ledger ids. Finance will coordinate re-init authorizations and confirm no double-debit.

ops-bot: Monitoring rule created: payment.routing_length_mismatch -> alert #oncall-payments

sarah_support: I'll draft customer comms: apology + explanation + ETA. Customers will be asked to confirm they do not re-upload or re-initiate meanwhile.

customer_orion: thanks. Please DM as soon as it's reprocessed. Our AP team was about to reattempt wires.

mike_sre: will do. Adding temporary logging to capture submitted_vs_sent for 48h for forensics. PR: https://git.redwood/ENG-10111/patch

payments-bot: Note: bulk reprocess will respect existing idempotency keys to avoid double debit.

sarah_support: thanks everyone. Closing loop with customer shortly.
